+# Incident Postmortem: Booklogr API High p99 Latency & Edge Client Jitter
+
+## Incident Summary
+On 2026-07-22, alerts `EdgeClientRequestJitter` and `BooklogrApiLatencyP99High` fired. The `booklogr-api` service experienced elevated p99 latency (~490ms, exceeding the 300ms SLA threshold), causing request jitter on upstream edge traffic.
+
+## Root Cause
+Commit `249bad30536d7b77d763a581541c90fc8f40d1df` ("Schema cleanup: drop unused books title index") introduced migration `e2a9d4c1b6f8_drop_unused_books_title_index.py` which dropped composite index `ix_books_owner_lower_title` on `books(owner_id, lower(title))`.
+
+The default route handler for GET `/v1/books` in `api/routes/books.py` (`get_books`) queries `Books.query.filter(Books.owner_id == claim_id)` and orders by `func.lower(getattr(Books, sort_by))` (where `sort_by` defaults to `"title"`). Dropping `ix_books_owner_lower_title` caused queries on GET `/v1/books` to perform unindexed scans and in-memory sorts, causing p99 latency to spike to ~490ms.
+
+## Evidence
+1. **Alertmanager (`ALERTMANAGER_URL`)**: Firing alert `BooklogrApiLatencyP99High`: "p99 HTTP request latency is 492.4ms (threshold 300ms) for the booklogr-api service."
+2. **Prometheus Metrics (`PROM_URL`)**:
+   - Query `sum by (path) (rate(flask_http_request_duration_seconds_sum[1m])) / sum by (path) (rate(flask_http_request_duration_seconds_count[1m]))` identified `/v1/books` as the latency hotspot (~242ms avg, ~490ms p99).
+3. **Git History (`git log`, `git show 249bad3`)**: Identified recent commit `249bad3` dropping `ix_books_owner_lower_title`.
+4. **Codebase Inspection (`api/routes/books.py`)**: Confirmed `get_books()` sorts by `lower(title)` while filtering by `owner_id`, matching the dropped index definition in `b7c3e1f9a2d4_add_books_owner_title_index.py`.
+
+## Corrective Actions & Resolution
+- Added new Alembic migration `migrations/versions/f3b8e2d1c0a9_restore_books_owner_title_index.py` (chained after `e2a9d4c1b6f8`) to restore composite index `ix_books_owner_lower_title` on `books([owner_id, lower(title)])`.
+- Committed migration to `main`.
